name: @hydronium-js/dom-client
description: Hydronium's browser client runtime: WASM Lua VM boot, DOM bridge, mount/hydrate, dev HMR client, JS-island bootstrap, and the dev error overlay. Canonical source for what used to be hand-maintained under dom/src/hydronium_dom/client/ -- that tree is now a generated, drift-checked copy of this package's src/. Ships with ZERO runtime dependencies: the Lua VM (wasmoon) is vendored into src/vendor/wasmoon/ rather than depended on, so the runtime works with no bundler at all (a bare <script type="module">) and a consumer that DOES bundle does not download the same 423KB twice. wasmoon is a devDependency because the sync script vendors FROM it; consumers never resolve it.
